title: Wire VectorSearch DI + integration verification (entity → embedded → retrieved)
description: Wire the VectorSearch → GraphManager DI at sidecar startup that was deferred from Phase 1, then verify Phase 1 → Phase 2 integration end-to-end: a Character entity created via GraphManager gets embedded automatically and is retrievable through L5 Coordinator's analyze phase via real IterativeRetriever. This closes SC-3 from Phase 2 success criteria.
action: Step A: Locate sidecar startup code (likely src-tauri/bin/sidecar/index.js or gateway-server.js) where GraphManager and VectorSearch are instantiated. Add `graphManager.setVectorSearch(vectorSearchInstance)` call so embedding hooks fire on entity create/update/delete. Step B: Create `src-tauri/bin/sidecar/workflow/levels/level5-coordinator.integration.test.js` that: (1) instantiates real GraphManager + real VectorSearch (in tmp dir), wires them with setVectorSearch; (2) creates a Character entity `{name:'勇敢的战士', description:'a brave warrior who fights monsters'}` via graphManager.createEntity; (3) waits for embedding to settle (poll embeddings table or fixed setTimeout 200ms — embedding is fire-and-forget per Phase 1 review); (4) instantiates Level5Coordinator with default analysisRetriever (real IterativeRetriever); (5) calls execute({user_request:'find brave warrior characters'}); (6) asserts state.metadata.analysis contains a result whose preview/source matches the created Character.

criteria: Wired call passes a real VectorSearch instance, not null/undefined (grep -A2 'setVectorSearch' shows non-null arg)
Integration test contains 'createEntity' AND 'execute(' AND a Character with name '勇敢的战士'
cd src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run workflow/levels/level5-coordinator.integration.test.js exits 0
Test asserts state.metadata.analysis is non-empty array and at least one entry preview/source references the created Character
convergence.definition_of_done: Sidecar startup wires VectorSearch into GraphManager; integration test proves entity → embedding → retrieval pipeline works end-to-end through L5.

files.target: sidecar bootstrap (or gateway-server.js if container assembled there)
files.change: After GraphManager and VectorSearch construction, call `graphManager.setVectorSearch(vectorSearch)` (the exact insertion point depends on existing wiring — read first)
Real GraphManager + VectorSearch + Level5Coordinator E2E test for entity-create → embed → retrieve via L5 analyze phase

implementation: Read src-tauri/bin/sidecar/index.js and gateway-server.js to find where GraphManager and VectorSearch are constructed/registered. Look for `new GraphManager(` and `new VectorSearch(`.
Insert `graphManager.setVectorSearch(vectorSearch)` at the point both instances exist. If they live in different scopes, refactor to a shared bootstrap function — keep the change minimal.
Write integration test: tmp dir for db, real GraphManager (constructor needs db + optional VectorSearch), real VectorSearch (constructor needs vector store path), wire via setVectorSearch.
createEntity({type:'character', name:'勇敢的战士', description:'a brave warrior who fights monsters'}). Wait 200ms (embedding is fire-and-forget per phase 1 F-003).
Instantiate Level5Coordinator with no analysisRetriever override so it uses createDefaultAnalysisRetriever (which calls createIterativeRetriever). Override projectRoot to tmp dir.

Call l5.execute({user_request:'find brave warrior characters', domain:'novel'}). Assert state.metadata.analysis.length > 0 and at least one entry has source matching the created entity (e.g., source contains 'character' or preview contains 'warrior').

success_metrics: Phase 1 → Phase 2 pipeline proven via assertion on retrieval results

reference.pattern: Phase 1 PLN-005 noted DI wiring as deferred (verification.json notes[0])

rationale.chosen_approach: Folding DI wiring into the integration test ensures both halves of SC-3 (Phase 1 → Phase 2 connection) are proven by a single artifact.
decision_factors: Single source of truth for integration
rationale.tradeoffs: If DI wiring is non-trivial (e.g., needs container refactor), this task may grow — keep insertion minimal and surgical.

risks: Sidecar startup may not have a single bootstrap point — DI may need to happen at gateway-server.js request handler level instead. Read first before patching.
Real VectorSearch may need a small embedding model (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5) downloaded — test may need to skip if model not present in CI
